what: Which upstream commit Ultron was copied from, and which upstream drop a person last reviewed. Read by scripts/upstream_sync.py. Change it in the same pull request that adopts or sets aside a drop (docs/UPSTREAM_SYNC.md), never on its own.

upstream.name: FatihMakes/Mark-LVII
upstream.note: One GitHub repository that is renamed with each Mark (it was Mark-LVI when Ultron was copied). The number identifies it; the old name still opens it. It has no releases, tags or other branches: a new Mark is the first line of its readme.md changing.

base_note: The 2026-11-04 commit (MARK LVI, 56) that HANDOFF.md and docs/UPSTREAM_RESEARCH.md record as the source of the copy. A ledger entry with a 'reconciled' commit is measured from that commit instead.

reviewed.note: Looked at on 2026-11-22 for the plan in docs/UPSTREAM_SYNC.md. Nothing from it has been adopted yet. The two fingerprints are SHA-256 of upstream's LICENSE and requirements.txt with line endings normalised to LF; `python scripts/upstream_sync.py pin` prints them.
